text: Talking therapy helped a lot, especially understanding that what he did was not okay and that my fear made sense. I tried microdosing a few months later because a friend recommended it, and it brought back the paralysis feeling, so that was a mistake. Ending the relationship was the best thing I did.

Ich habe eine Traumatherapie mit EMDR begonnen, die mir langsam hilft. Am Anfang war es sehr schwer, weil jede Sitzung neue Erinnerungen hochgebracht hat. Ich war auch sechs Wochen in einer psychosomatischen Klinik, was mir Stabilität gegeben hat. Antidepressiva habe ich bekommen, aber sie haben mir nicht viel gebracht. Schädlich war, dass die Leute von der Zeremonie mir geraten haben, wiederzukommen, um es 'fertig zu verarbeiten'. Gut tut mir Malen und meine Hündin. Ich bin noch lange nicht über den Berg.
Time mostly. I stopped using drugs.

I went to grief counselling for about six months, which helped me deal with my dad's death and the shame about the trip. My counsellor helped me see that I was trying to find my dad in the only way I knew. I also slowly started hiking again, first in open landscapes with friends, then in forests. The first time I walked through a forest again I cried, but it was okay. I haven't taken psychedelics since and don't plan to.

I tried talking to the retreat organisers, who told me I was 'projecting' and that the facilitator was very experienced. That was harmful and set me back a lot.

I then looked for a therapist who understood both trauma and psychedelics. It took a while, and the first one I found was very judgemental about drug use. The second one was great. We've been working together for over a year, mainly on boundaries, shame, and body-based trauma work. It has helped a lot.

I found an online group for people who've been harmed in psychedelic settings. Hearing that others had similar experiences, sometimes with the same facilitators, was validating, though it also made me angry.

I started journaling and going on long walks. I stopped yoga for a while and recently started again with a teacher I trust, in a class where I can always leave.

I'm much better now, but I still have trouble with authority figures and I don't think I'll ever go to a group ceremony again.
Ich habe mit meiner Hausärztin gesprochen, die mich beruhigt hat. Außerdem haben mir Achtsamkeitsübungen geholfen und Gespräche mit meiner Freundin. Am meisten hat aber die Zeit geholfen.

I found a therapist who specialises in OCD and we did ERP (exposure and response prevention). It was very hard, for example holding a knife while being near my wife, but it worked. My doctor put me on sertraline at a fairly high dose, which also helped. What helped most was learning that intrusive thoughts are common and don't mean anything about who you are. I wish someone had told me that on the night of the trip. I've also told my wife about the thoughts and she was incredibly understanding. I'm doing much better now, maybe 90% recovered.

After the clinic I went to NA meetings, which I still do, and I have a sponsor. I also see a therapist every two weeks who specialises in addiction. Exercise and a regular routine have been key. I don't think I'd recommend ibogaine to everyone, but it gave me the start I needed.

Ich war ein Jahr lang in ambulanter Psychotherapie (Verhaltenstherapie) und habe Escitalopram bekommen. Das hat die Panikattacken reduziert, aber nicht ganz weggemacht. Danach war ich acht Wochen in einer Klinik für Angststörungen, wo ich viel Konfrontationstherapie gemacht habe, z.B. mit der Therapeutin in den Supermarkt gehen. Das hat mir am meisten geholfen. Weniger hilfreich war, dass mir viele Ärzte gesagt haben, dass mit mir körperlich nichts ist, ohne zu erklären, was stattdessen los ist. Ich habe immer noch Angst, aber ich kann wieder die meisten Dinge tun.
